BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO


SECTION 1,     Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby

amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols and

indications as shown on Map No. 6-G in an area bound by:




A line 239.00 feet north of and parallel to South Archer Avenue; South Loomis Avenue; a line 289.00 feet

south of and parallel to South Archer Avenue; and the alley next west of and parallel to South Loomis

Avenue.




To those of a RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2.     This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.




Common Address of Property 2924-28 S Loomis St.
